central_claims.basis: The November 9 disposing entry and per curiam stay the injunction pending a timely certiorari petition and its disposition, without summary reversal.
central_claims.claim: The Court will grant an unqualified stay pending the timely filing and disposition of a certiorari petition, not immediately summarily reverse.

central_claims.basis: The per curiam holds the Government exceedingly likely to establish lack of jurisdiction and expressly treats the major-questions doctrine as statutory interpretation, not a constitutional cause of action.
central_claims.claim: The decisive likelihood-of-success ground will be that a statutory-authority objection cannot become a constitutional claim by invoking the major-questions doctrine.

central_claims.basis: The per curiam relies on border-security interests, unrecoverable daily costs, and Congress's preference for expeditious construction in balancing the harms.
central_claims.claim: Construction disruption and border-security injuries will outweigh respondents' environmental and historic-resource objections for interim purposes.
